payload.rewritten_goal:
You are coordinating a team of enterprise operations specialists responding to an emergency facilities incident for client EmberWave Studios. The provided water-damage photos, insurer checklist evidence summary, and temporary-space layout evidence summary must be reviewed. MANDATORY steps: 1. the policy_analyst must inspect the insurer checklist and internal emergency response SOP to confirm evidence and relocation requirements, 2. the workplace_services_admin must identify affected devices for the named impacted staff and unassign only the water-damaged assets that must be pulled from service, 3. the finance_ops_analyst must retrieve the tagged emergency expense lines and optimize the retained incident-spend plan, 4. the vendor_coordinator must retrieve the scoped facilities incident, assign it to the Emergency Workplace Response group, and create one follow-up incident for temporary seating execution, 5. the operations_manager must provide a concise response summary without exposing serial numbers, employee locations, or raw costs.

Relevant document evidence summaries are inlined below:
- insurer evidence checklist: Insurance checklist specifying exact evidence retention, damaged-asset logging, and relocation preconditions required before service actions. Extracted content: Insurer Evidence Checklist Insurance checklist specifying exact evidence retention, damaged-asset logging, and relocation preconditions required before service actions. Details Document Title Water Damage Insurance Evidence & Mitigation Checklist Insured/Client Name EmberWave Studios Incident Type sudden water intrusion / building leak Section Heading Appears Required Evidence Before Cleanup Photo Requirement capture wide-angle and close-up photos of all affected areas before moving items Logging Requirement record each damaged asset with asset tag or serial number, location, condition, and owner/assigned user Retention Requirement retain damaged equipment and materials for insurer inspection until written release is received Service Restriction do not discard, repair, reimage, or replace damaged devices before evidence capture and insurer approval Relocation Precondition impacted staff may be moved to temporary space only after workstation photos and damaged-asset logs are completed It Handling Requirement if a device is wet, disconnect power and label it do not power on Submission Requirement send evidence package including photos, inventory log, and incident timeline to insurance adjuster and internal risk management Checklist Version = Rev Checklist Version Rev. 2025.2 Additional Information a realistic 2-page corporate insurer checklist document using reportlab Use clean business formatting with section headers, checkboxes, and bullet lists sections such as immediate site stabilization, required evidence before cleanup, damaged asset logging, prohibited actions, and relocation preconditions Page 2 continue with a tabular checklist for documentation and submission steps, plus a sign-off area for facilities lead and policy/risk review This policy is confidential and
- temp space layout: Temporary swing-space layout identifying approved relocation seats for the impacted staff after evidence capture. Extracted content: Temp Space Layout Temporary swing-space layout identifying approved relocation seats for the impacted staff after evidence capture. Details Document Title Temporary Swing Space Seating Layout Organization/Client Name EmberWave Studios Layout Floor/Area 3rd Floor Training Suite converted to swing space Approved Relocation Zone Zone B only Note Appears relocate staff only after evidence capture is complete Seat Assignment Maya Chen -> B-12 Seat Assignment Jordan Patel -> B-14 Seat Assignment Sofia Ramirez -> B-15 Seat Assignment Liam O'Connor -> B-16 Equipment Note docking stations available at all approved seats Printer/Copier Location shared MFP near Zone B entrance It Support Note loaner devices issued from temporary IT desk in reception alcove Additional Information a realistic 1-page office space planning document using reportlab In the center, show a simplified labeled floor layout using boxes and outlines for rooms, corridors, reception alcove, printer area, and seating zones a small legend explaining symbols for desk, printer, IT desk, and approved seating a right-side notes panel with relocation instructions and readiness notes This report is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
